audit.whatIsWrong: QA lint pass: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits; dosFull[1].d was verbatim tradeGood and dontsFull[2].d was verbatim tradeBad (copy-paste bleed).
audit.why: Deterministic lint (COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT, COPY_PASTE_BLEED). Kit: Pick a Card W cd 6s; Destiny R cd 170/140/110.
audit.corrected: Cooldown numbers added from the kit; both bled bullets rewritten to match their own titles.

edits.before: - Twisted Fate Pick a Card (Gold): matchup-defining — The locked gold card starts every trade and gank — back off the moment it glows yellow. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W gold card like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Twisted Fate Pick a Card (Gold): matchup-defining — his W runs the same 6s clock as yours; back off when it glows yellow and answer with your own lock. - Guard your gold card like a fifth summoner spell. - Destiny is 170/140/110s — kill windows only.

edits.before: Lock gold off-screen, walk up once, card-auto-Q, and leave — one stun-chunk per cycle is all the lane asks of you.
edits.after: Hit 6 with the wave crashing — the first Destiny to leave with cards up wins the map, so shove before the timer, not after.

edits.before: Cycling cards inside his engage range for stacked-deck greed — TF dies in exactly one mistimed auto-walk per game; don't pre-book it.
edits.after: Trading autos while Pick a Card spins hands the mirror to him — the TF who locks gold first takes the exchange outright; lock, then walk.
